The jist of it is, that the developers became greedy and realized a paid subscription made them more money.
Rather than changing facerig to a subscription based system for new users, they decided to just ditch it. They "supposedly" created a new system and released it as a new software. it's not...it's just facrerig repackaged.

This old facerig will no longer receive updates or fixes. They claim "to want to do right" for their existing users, so they'll keep the old software up for use.
Ok, that's cool right? Oh, but they didn't disable purchasing it. Yep, they are setting it up so people can buy it still, even after being abandoned, and then most likely these users will be forced to also go for the subscription based version.

Everything they are doing is scummy.

Don't support these guys, they deserve none of it.

I have one good thing and several not good things to say about this game.

The good part is the artwork. Beautiful visuals, wonderful backgrounds, kind of Samurai Jack - vibes.

Other than that, the game is a waste of time. Fans of LIMBO, INSIDE, Black the Fall, Little Nightmares etc. will find this game a poor excuse for the titles listed above:

The puzzles are simplistic at best,
The progression is not always clear,
Bosses are unsatisfying,
Too many loading screens.

Overall it is a nonsensical game. Obviously most people enjoyed it but I wouldn't put it up there with the other titles. I was very excited about it; alas it was a waste of time. Even DARQ was a better game.

At least the hearts of the creators were in the right place, or at least adjacent to the right place. I hope that their next titles will have more work and intelligence behind them.

If you like the 2013 reboot, ROTTR will be right up your alley. It is constructed in a very similar fashion.  The combat/exploration ratio is about what it was in the original (~30/70).  

Pros:
- Looks amazing
- An open-ish world with a lot of stuff to discover and explore
- Fun platforming
- Good (enough) story. It isnt anything id brag about, but it works and is entertaining.
- Great characters
- TONS of content including user made challanges, a survival mode (like surviving the cold, etc), and more and lots stuff to go back and discover. This will certainly last you a while.

Cons:
- Gun combat isnt a fast or fluid as you might want it to be. But it works.
- A few of the plot twists i kinda saw coming, but the story is entertaining nonetheless.
